definitions.prompt: Length of separately tokenized prompt, including BOS/header; full-sample prefix equality checked for every row.
definitions.answer: Full-sample tokens overlapping original stripped answer character span.
definitions.other: Remaining tokens, terminal EOS/EOT for these data; boundary overlaps assigned to answer.
definitions.prompt_separate: Prompt separately tokenized; used by TRL completion mask, may differ at boundary.
definitions.stop_lost: Appended eos_token for current; assistant eot_id for chat. Not necessarily the same token.
definitions.padding: CPU arithmetic on keep_start capped lengths; dynamic batches in manifest order, no packing or pad multiple.
definitions.gpu: No measured GPU VRAM or speed; token slots are workload estimates, not VRAM predictions.

train.formatting_func_with_completion_only_err: A formatting function was provided while `completion_only_loss=True`, which is incompatible. Using a formatter converts the dataset to a language modeling type, conflicting with completion-only loss. To resolve this, apply your formatting function before passing the dataset, or disable `completion_only_loss` in `SFTConfig`.
